risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: WEX explicitly states that the company regularly experiences cyberattacks and expects more in the future. Potential impacts include liability, reputational damage and financial impacts. Security measures are costly and cannot guarantee absolute protection.

risks.title: Anti-corruption law compliance
risks.score_rationale: WEX operates in multiple foreign jurisdictions and is subject to the FCPA, UK Bribery Act 2010 and other anti-corruption laws. Violations could result in significant fines and increased oversight. The trend toward greater scrutiny has increased in recent years.

risks.title: Data protection and compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with strict data protection regulations in multiple jurisdictions. These efforts are costly and time-consuming in a constantly evolving regulatory environment.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: WEX operates in highly competitive payments and financial services markets where other players offer similar services, threatening market share.

risks.title: Dependence on technology and IT infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: WEX operations rely heavily on complex technology systems. Technology failures or cyberattacks could disrupt critical services and impact revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: WEX Inc. does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Information provided focuses primarily on financial statements, business segments (Mobility, Corporate Payments, Benefits) and operations without addressing AI-related aspects.
